mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 inducer that may increase lithium clearance, potentially reducing lithium levels and therapeutic efficacy; both drugs can cause CNS effects and tremor.
action: Monitor lithium levels closely, particularly after cenobamate initiation or dose changes; adjust lithium dose as needed to maintain therapeutic range (0.6-1.2 mEq/L); ensure adequate renal function and hydration status.
